description: This file defines a PHP interface 'LoaderInterface' within the Twig templating engine. The interface specifies methods that all loader classes must implement, including retrieving source context, cache keys, freshness status, and existence checks for templates.

classes.name: Twig\Loader\LoaderInterface
classes.description: Defines the contract that all Twig loader classes must implement, including methods for retrieving source context, cache key, freshness status, and existence of templates.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context for a given template name or throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Provides the cache key used for caching the specified template, or throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Determines if the template is fresh based on the last modification time, or throws LoaderError if the template is not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks if a template exists by name.
